title: The Silent Voyage

plot: A mountaineering expedition turns deadly when a storm traps the climbers near the summit with dwindling oxygen.

plot: In a town where paper books are banned, a shopkeeper hides a secret library and falls for a government inspector.

plot: When the power grid fails nationwide, an engineer and a soldier fight to restart the reactors before order collapses.

plot: Astronomers point a new telescope at the oldest light in the universe and question humanity's place in the cosmos.

title: The Marathon of Mr. Okafor
plot: A retired postman trains to run his first marathon at seventy to honor a promise made to his late wife.

title: Cinder Alley
plot: A rookie detective hunts an arsonist through the back streets of a city that would rather look the other way.

title: Songbird Station
plot: A night-shift radio host connects lonely listeners across the city with the songs they are afraid to request.

title: The Cartographer's Daughter
plot: A girl follows her missing father's half-finished maps across deserts and jungles to uncover a hidden valley.
